featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my extreme dissatisfaction with my recent stay at your resort. Unfortunately, the experience was highly disappointing for several reasons.

Upon our arrival at approximately 11:15 p.m., we were left waiting for over 15 minutes without any response from your staff. Once we were settled, we found the washroom to be in a very shabby condition and discovered there was no hot water supply.

Regarding the dining experience, the food served to us at night was chilled. While the breakfast the following morning was tasty, it was also served very cold. Furthermore, the recreational facilities were unacceptable; the swimming pool was in a poor state, with water that appeared extremely dirty.

The road conditions leading to the resort from Nalasopara station were also very poor, making the 8 km journey quite difficult. Due to these combined issues, we decided to cut our trip short and depart at 11:00 a.m. the next morning.

I believe these conditions are not up to standard, and I wanted to bring these matters to your attention. I look forward to hearing your thoughts on how this can be addressed.

I am writing to express my extreme dissatisfaction with my recent stay at your resort. Unfortunately, the experience was highly disappointing and far below acceptable standards.

Due to all these issues, we had no choice but to cut our trip short and leave the resort at 11:00 a.m. the very next day.
Overall, this experience was extremely disappointing and not worth the time or money spent. The resort needs serious improvement in cleanliness, service, food quality, and maintenance. I would not recommend this place to anyone unless major changes are made.

featured_reviews.name: Colin Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
Green Hill Resort in Nalasopara is a decent option for a short outing, especially for families and group picnics. The resort is surrounded by greenery and offers a calm environment away from city noise. The swimming pool and open lawn area are the main attractions and are enjoyable for children and groups.

The rooms are basic and suitable for short stays, though maintenance and cleanliness could be improved. Food provided is average in taste with limited variety, but it is sufficient for group bookings. Staff members are generally helpful and cooperative.

Overall, Green Hill Resort is best suited for one-day picnics, school or parish outings, and small group celebrations. It is a budget-friendly place, but not ideal for those looking for luxury or premium facilities.
